description.value:
You lock minds with the target, trying to mentally subdue them. The target must attempt a Will save. Each time you Sustain this Spell, the target attempts another Will save.

Critical Success You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stunned]{Stunned 1} and the spell ends.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is stunned 1.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stunned]{Stunned 2}.

Three illusory images of you swirl about your space, potentially causing those who attack you to hit one of the images instead of you. Any attack that would hit you has a random chance of hitting one of your images instead of you. If all three images remain, there is a 1 in 4 chance of hitting you (1 on [[/r 1d4]]). With two images remaining, there is a 1 in 3 chance of hitting you (1-2 on [[/r 1d6]]). With only one image, the chances are 1 in 2 (1-3 on [[/r 1d6]]).

Once an image is hit, it is destroyed. If an attack roll fails to hit your AC but doesn't critically fail, it destroys an image but has no additional effect (even if the attack would normally have an effect on a failure). If an attack roll is a critical success and would hit one of the images, one of the images is destroyed and the attack roll becomes a success against you. Once all the images are destroyed, the spell ends.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Spell Effect: Mirror Image]

You enhance the eyes of the target, allowing them to see through fog, smoke, or vapor in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] from themself; they ignore concealment from such effects in the area. This doesn't prevent them from experiencing adverse effects from poisons or particulates in the air within the area.

Heightened (4th) You target up to four willing creatures within 30 feet.

You call forth a cloud of mist. All creatures within the mist become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Concealed], and all creatures outside the mist become concealed to creatures within it. You can Dismiss the cloud.

You send out a flock of crows that torments the target with beak and talon. Make a ranged spell attack against a target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 6d4 piercing damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Dazzled] for 1 round (double damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Blinded] for 1 round on a critical hit).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 3d4.
